title: Caspian Blue Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: Caspian Blue Cottage is a striking coastal retreat offering over 4,200 square feet of elevated comfort in the serene community of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea. This thoughtfully designed five-bedroom, five-and-a-half-bathroom home brings together luxurious touches and laid-back charm, with standout features like Calcutta Gold quartz countertops, top-tier KitchenAid appliances, and sun-drenched interiors. The open-concept layout connects two beautifully furnished living areas to a chef’s kitchen and a screened porch perfect for breezy gatherings. Each bedroom is a serene escape with spa-like bathrooms, while the oversized bunkroom provides a playful, yet refined setting for larger groups or families. Surrounded by lush landscaping and backing up to protected state forest, Caspian Blue Cottage delivers a sense of peace just moments from adventure. Guests are steps away from a heated community pool and a short stroll or golf cart ride to the private beach access. With bikes, a golf cart, and the scenic Timpochee Trail at your doorstep, exploring nearby favorites like Alys Beach and The Hub is effortless. Whether lounging in the shade of a screened porch or setting out for sunset rides along 30A, this home is an exceptional blend of tranquility, convenience, and beachside luxury.
